format: Kotlin (Java interoperability, test class using JUnit)
description: This is a unit test class for the SystemHandler component, focusing on handling system notifications including authorization, validation, and posting behavior.

classes.name: SystemHandlerTest
classes.description: Contains unit tests for the SystemHandler class, verifying notification handling logic under different scenarios.

classes.name: FakePoster
classes.description: Mock implementation of SystemNotificationPoster for testing, tracks number of posts and last request.

classes.name: ThrowingPoster
classes.description: Mock implementation that throws exceptions when post is called, simulates failure scenarios.

methods.name: handleSystemNotify_rejectsUnauthorized
methods.description: Tests that unauthorized posters are rejected with NOT_AUTHORIZED error.

methods.name: handleSystemNotify_rejectsEmptyNotification
methods.description: Validates rejection of empty or whitespace-only notification title and body.

methods.name: handleSystemNotify_rejectsInvalidRequestObject
methods.description: Tests rejection when required fields are missing in the request JSON.

methods.name: handleSystemNotify_postsNotification
methods.description: Checks successful posting when valid notification data is provided.

methods.name: handleSystemNotify_trimsAndPassesOptionalFields
methods.description: Verifies that optional fields are properly trimmed and passed to the poster.

methods.name: handleSystemNotify_returnsUnauthorizedWhenPostFailsPermission
methods.description: Tests handling of security exceptions during posting, expecting NOT_AUTHORIZED error.

methods.name: handleSystemNotify_returnsUnavailableWhenPostFailsUnexpectedly
methods.description: Tests fallback error handling for unexpected failures during notification posting.
